hooks.command: echo '## Session Context' && echo 'Branch:' $(git branch --show-current 2>/dev/null || echo 'not a git repo') && echo 'Recent changes:' && git diff --stat HEAD~3 2>/dev/null | tail -8 && echo '---' && if [ -f .claude/memory/project_status.md ]; then echo '## Active Task' && head -30 .claude/memory/project_status.md; else echo 'No active task file.'; fi
echo 'Context compacting. Review what was learned this session and update auto-memory with any new patterns, corrections, or gotchas before context is reduced.'
